original_case_assessment.declared_method: Single-context baseline document review; no Qore or independent-role method invoked.

criteria.definition: Accurate relevant project rules and distinct focus destinations.
criteria.rationale: The review accurately identifies the help key sequence, distinct Close/summary and Back/introduction-heading focus, unanswered state, policy limits, locale and viewport. It explicitly exposes current Tab versus target/checker Tab/Shift+Tab and recommends Tab for literal source alignment without inventing a deployment defect.

criteria.definition: Sequential keyboard traversal and Enter evidence for Back; click or programmatic focus alone is insufficient.
criteria.rationale: The review recognizes that the corrected Back instruction supplies sequential traversal and Enter rather than a click-only proof. It does not equate that written step with actual browser observations or treat the unmeasured 24-step cap as a proved failure.
criteria.uncertainty: Actual deployed keyboard traversal/Enter/focus remain UNKNOWN; the criterion is assessed as a static-review evidence standard.

criteria.definition: Unanswered state and enforced activation, network and origin boundaries.
criteria.rationale: The review preserves unanswered state and supports the missing method/origin policy and blocked-effect evidence finding. It proposes pre-navigation enforcement/checking, retains possible external-harness uncertainty, and reports no actual forbidden request.
criteria.uncertainty: Actual browser network enforcement and blocked-request effects remain unobserved; sandbox denial is not a site acceptance result.

criteria.definition: Evidence or explicit uncertainty; never mislabel a protocol fixture result as a website defect.
criteria.rationale: All three findings have source/document evidence, explicit qualifications and fixture attribution. The locale/viewport finding is described as missing scope/reproducibility proof rather than demonstrated layout behavior.

criteria.definition: Relevant checker command and acceptance checks for planning/review; proposed and executed commands remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: The checker command, working directory, actual exit 0 and complete stdout are retained in check-contract.txt. The report separates proposed acceptance corrections from actual static consistency execution and states its limit.

criteria.definition: Any finding on the corrected comparator is supported; an empty review is permitted, not required.
criteria.rationale: The nonempty result is supported: F1 and F2 correspond to unrepaired help/policy obligations; F3 observes that neither declared locale nor viewport is set or recorded in the target. F3 does not require a live layout failure to establish a documentary scope omission, and it is qualified accordingly. No continuing missing-Back-proof finding is invented.
criteria.uncertainty: The other reviewers' choice not to promote locale/viewport is preserved as a difference in supported judgment, not proof that F3 is false or that this run is superior. An empty review is allowed but not required.

criteria.definition: Scoped decision supported by actual observations.
criteria.rationale: The actual outcome is three documentary omissions, with supported scope, source identity, actual checker limit and unobserved deployment/runtime behavior. The baseline correctly does not manufacture Qore phases or independent verification.

method_assessment.phase_inventory: The complete baseline report, actual checker result, input hashes and raw input tree are retained. Baseline has no mandatory finder/redactor/verifier/profile phases.
method_assessment.complete_substantiated: Yes, for the requested static baseline document review only. No independent verification or website acceptance is claimed.
uncertainty: The baseline reasoning has no independently dispatched verifier by design.
Runtime website behavior, real focus path length and browser policy effects remain unobserved.
The enclosing candidate/prepared-input hashes are supplied metadata and not independently reconstructed.
Retained command record supports actual checker execution; the evaluator did not replay it or inspect native trial events.

limits: Neutral filenames did not blind conditions.
The raw criterion judgments concern their declared task scope; later method-coverage qualification is separate.
